If a baseline defect is reproduced, reuse/update the existing defect bead; create a bounded implementation bead only after proving no adequate existing owner. No duplicate frontend/replay/nested compiler implementation.

For each named handler in function:31:4 and master44.16, record the exact production entrypoint and registered check; assert the valid response/correlation and command-specific effect, and a contract-defined invalid case with exact response/error and no unauthorized state/journal mutation. The eleven handler names are: handle_submit_run, handle_submit_run_inline, handle_cancel_run, handle_inspect_run, handle_list_events, handle_answer_ask, handle_complete_action, handle_fail_action, handle_drain_trace, handle_health, handle_shutdown. Keep vb-eirmk.24.1 frame encode/decode distinct. Record current pin, raw receipts, and separate CODE and independent TEST dispositions.
